text:
tomás ramos: Hi team — quick help pls. Took a late taxi after a client dinner in DUB and only got a crumpled receipt pic. Card statement shows a DCC charge (merchant applied dynamic currency conv) and the total is €48.50 but bank billed $58.23 and added a $6 "service" fee. I paid on personal card. Need reimbursement + can we dispute the DCC?
ella (travel-ops): ugh DCC, hate that. Can you upload the photo of the receipt and the bank charge screenshot? Also which card used (last 4)?
tomás ramos: uploading now — receipt.jpg shows handwritten tip, hard to read amount but merchant line says TAXI DUBLIN 48.50 EUR. Bank screenshot attached: shows 58.23 USD + service 6.00 USD = 64.23 USD. last4 = 7788.
card-bot: NOTICE: Detected potential DCC. Merchants in EU sometimes show local and converted amounts. Recommend contacting merchant for corrected receipt within 30 days or file a dispute with issuing bank. Opened internal ticket FIN-8463.
marc (manager): Confirming this was client-facing travel (meet w/ Derry Labs). Approve reimbursement for EUR 48.50 (or USD equivalent). Marc approves.
hana (finance): Thanks Tomas. Need a few items to process: 1) clearer receipt or merchant folio (photo ok), 2) bank conversion screenshot, 3) short note confirming merchant refused to reprint itemized folio if they did. If merchant will not reissue, we can reimburse based on merchant charge with manager approval but will record DCC loss as non-reimbursable unless exception approved.
tomás ramos: I asked the driver and the pub where it dropped me off — they said they can't reprint. Driver said "no system" and gave verbal. Uploaded a 2nd photo showing licence plate and driver name.
ella (travel-ops): If driver can't, do you have a card terminal slip? sometimes taxi rank keeps copies. Otherwise manager note + bank screenshot might be enough.
tomás ramos: no terminal slip. only crumpled photo + bank screenshot + my message log with driver (sms) where he confirms fare 48.5 EUR. Uploaded sms_screenshot.jpg.
hana (finance): OK. Because this is small and manager approved, we can do a one-time exception for the DCC loss. Please confirm you want reimbursement in USD (bank) or EUR (converted at daily rate). Payout in USD is faster.
tomás ramos: USD ok please (my bank account is USD). Also, how long will payout take? I have a team social tomorrow and low funds. :grimacing:
hana (finance): Standard is 3-5 business days. We can mark as PRIORITY for same-week payout if manager explicitly requests priority and expense flagged. Marc, can you mark priority?
marc (manager): Marking priority. Need to retain doc trail for audit but approve priority payout.
hana (finance): Marked PRIORITY under FIN-8463-P. One more ask: paste a 1-sentence summary of why this was business travel and why DCC couldn't be avoided (for audit).
tomás ramos: "Late taxi after client meeting; driver couldn't issue electronic receipt and merchant applied DCC at payment; client-facing event."
hana (finance): Received. Payout queued. Expected bank settlement 2 business days. Note: We'll reimburse $64.23 (bank posted total) and classify $6 service as reimbursable exception (one-time) because of client necessity and manager sign-off.
card-bot: FIN-8463 updated: reimbursement queued; fraud detection cleared.
tomás ramos: Thank you all 60a. Also filing a help ticket with the card issuer to ask about the DCC reversal process.
ella (travel-ops): Good plan. Tip: if you travel EU again, ask for payment in local currency or decline conversion to avoid DCC.
tomás ramos: will do. Saved me a headache.
hana (finance): Closing thread once payout posts. If payout fails or bank declines, we'll fallback to a payroll advance option — finance will DM you.
